headline: Senior Backend & Full-Stack Software Engineer | Python, Java, Cloud-Native Microservices
summary: Results-driven Software Engineer with over 5 years of professional experience designing, building, and scaling backend and full-stack web applications. Proven expertise in production environments using Python, Java, and PostgreSQL, alongside modern cloud infrastructure on Azure and AWS with Docker and Kubernetes. Track record of optimizing high-throughput microservices, establishing automated CI/CD pipelines, and delivering complex enterprise solutions in Agile/Scrum teams.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Architected and maintained 15+ cloud-native backend microservices in Python (FastAPI) and Java (Spring Boot) backed by PostgreSQL and MySQL databases, serving over 500,000 daily active users.
Led the migration of legacy monolithic workloads to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) using Docker and Helm, reducing infrastructure costs by 28% and improving deployment reliability.
Built and maintained internal admin dashboards and customer-facing analytics modules using React and TypeScript.
Designed and implemented automated CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI and GitHub Actions, cutting average release deployment times from 45 minutes to 8 minutes.
Acted as technical lead in an Agile/Scrum squad of 6 engineers, conducting code reviews, sprint planning, and mentoring 3 junior developers.

experience.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
bullets: Developed and maintained core RESTful APIs in Python (Django) and Java, managing large-scale relational data schemas in PostgreSQL with over 50 million records.
Optimized complex SQL queries and implemented Redis caching layers, decreasing average API p95 response latency by 42%.
Implemented responsive frontend interfaces using React and TypeScript in collaboration with UX/UI designers.
Containerized applications with Docker and deployed staging and production stacks on AWS (ECS and EKS) within a bi-weekly Scrum release cycle.

experience.title: Junior Backend Developer
bullets: Contributed to backend feature development in Java and MySQL for B2B logistics software.
Wrote unit and integration tests using JUnit and Pytest, increasing overall backend test coverage from 55% to 84%.
Participated in daily Agile stand-ups, backlog refinement, and automated build configuration with Jenkins.
